create_AlignmentCRF_monotone: create an AlignmentCRF with monotone_one_to_many alignment type for sequence alignment
create_AlignmentCRF_many_to_many: create an AlignmentCRF with monotone_many_to_many alignment type for flexible sequence alignment
create_AlignmentCRF_non_monotone: create an AlignmentCRF with non_monotone_one_to_one alignment type for optimal pair alignment
run_AlignmentCRF_argmax: run AlignmentCRF argmax to find the best alignment from log potentials
run_AlignmentCRF_marginals: run AlignmentCRF marginals to compute per-cell alignment probabilities
